question: In a certain code language, ‘JACCUZI’ is written as ‘KZDBVYJ’ and ‘QUIZZER’ is written as ‘RTJYADS’. How will ‘BUZZWIG’ be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabet and their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

The pattern followed in the given codes is:

The alphabet at odd places are increased by 1 positional value.

The alphabet at even places are decreased by 1 positional value.</sp
